topic: Sleep and eyes: what poor sleep does (dryness, twitching, strain)

youtube.title: 3 things bad sleep does to your eyes 😴 #Shorts
youtube.description:
Slept badly? Your eyes feel it first. Here are 3 things poor sleep does to them.
தூக்கம் குறைந்தால் கண் வறட்சி, இமை துடிப்பு, கண் சோர்வு வரலாம்.

• During sleep, closed eyelids keep the eye surface moist and eye muscles rest.
• Poor sleep plus late screens can leave eyes dry, red and irritated.
• Eyelid twitching is often linked to tiredness, stress and too much caffeine, and usually settles with rest.
• Tired focusing muscles bring heavy eyes, blurred reading and evening headaches.
• Health experts say adults need about 7 or more hours of sleep a night.
• Phone away an hour before bed, dim lights, and a cool, clean, damp cloth on tired eyes.
• Twitching for weeks, a drooping eyelid or other face twitches: see a doctor.

gmb.text: Poor sleep shows up in your eyes first. While you sleep, closed eyelids keep the eye surface moist and the eye muscles rest. Short nights and late screens can leave eyes dry, red and irritated, cause eyelid twitching (often linked to tiredness, stress and too much caffeine) and bring eye strain with heavy eyes, blurred reading and evening headaches. Adults need about seven or more hours of sleep a night. Put the phone away an hour before bed, dim the lights, and rest a cool, clean, damp cloth on tired eyes. If twitching lasts for weeks, the eyelid droops or other parts of the face twitch, see a doctor. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
